void invitation_render (frame_buffer_t * buf, terminal_size_t size, const char * session_string, bool joining, int animation_frame, bool use_colors)

Render the discovery invitation into a frame without writing to the terminal. An empty string shows creation progress; joining shows connection progress. Text is plain ASCII, and the Run instruction immediately follows the string.
